metadata.label: WASM (Envoy)
metadata.note: Paired cells, one per tier per replicate. Latency trends are MILLISECONDS (k6); internal token timings are MICROSECONDS (edge logs, wadm tier only); cpu.*.cpu_us_per_request is CPU microseconds over the measured window from the host cgroup sampler, divided by k6.edge_requests. The origin tier sends the same probes to the origin directly, with the edge idle: it has no cpu.edge, alerts or timing_lines. Only cells with validity.valid may be reported.

edge.note: affinity_cpus is sched_getaffinity (respects cpuset); online_cpus is _SC_NPROCESSORS_ONLN, which nginx's `worker_processes auto` uses and which ignores the cpuset. oversubscribed=true means more workers than pinned cores.

origin.note: affinity_cpus is sched_getaffinity (respects cpuset); online_cpus is _SC_NPROCESSORS_ONLN, which nginx's `worker_processes auto` uses and which ignores the cpuset. oversubscribed=true means more workers than pinned cores.

reasons: host froze the VM for 13 s inside the window (kernel soft lockup / clock jump)
